story: Sophie is in the garden. [emotion:QT/surprised] Sophie sees a tiny fairy sitting on a red flower. The fairy has shiny wings and a little wand. The fairy is trying to reach three bright stars. The stars are up in the tall tree. Sophie gets a big stick. Sophie and the fairy push the stick under the tree. The three stars fall down. [emotion:QT/happy] The fairy picks up the stars and puts them in a little bag. [emotion:QT/happy] "Thank you!" the fairy says to Sophie.
